name: NIMPH Threat Reflex
description: A provisional reflex package in which NIMPH accelerates defensive motor response when a lethal trajectory is detected.
appearance: The Nikke moves before conscious recognition; targeting overlays flash a single red vector across her vision.
activation: Reaction when a visible attack would cause severe HP, Cover, or Stability loss.
effect: Relocate a minimal distance or brace automatically, reducing the incoming attack’s effect without cancelling it.
outcomeGuidance: The reflex preserves a chance to survive; it does not negate an honestly established lethal threat or bypass blocked movement.
limitations: Once per round.
Cannot respond to an undetected attack.
Cannot move through an occupied, sealed, or otherwise impossible route.
counters: Concealed attacks, immobilisation, signal interference, or attacks covering every viable escape vector.

limitations: Simulation-only.

name: Simulation Override: Reset Vector
description: A GM-controlled Simulation Room safety override that resets corrupted positioning data without rewinding narrative events.
appearance: The environment freezes into wireframe for a fraction of a second before combatants reappear at their last verified coordinates.
activation: Manual simulation administrator intervention after position state becomes invalid or contradictory.
effect: Return affected entities to their last verified legal positions. HP, ammunition, cooldowns, choices, and completed events remain unchanged.
outcomeGuidance: Use only to repair invalid engine state, never to rescue a character from an honest consequence or revise a valid tactical outcome.
limitations: Administrator-only.
Cannot restore HP, ammunition, Cover, Stability, reactions, or spent resources.
Cannot undo a valid event or player decision.
